title: Sightline settings
description: Settings for Sightline in this repository. Sightline uses the nearest sightline.json in the current folder or a folder above it. Options given on the command line win over this file.

$schema.description: Where editors find the description of these settings.

solution.description: The .sln, .slnx or .csproj file to open, relative to this file. Without it, Sightline opens the solution in the current folder.

exclude.description: Projects to leave off the map. Each entry is a project name, a folder or a path relative to this file, and may use * (within a folder name) and ** (across folders). Left-out projects still load when others reference them, so code that uses them is read correctly.

port.description: Port for the map page. When it is busy, the next free port is used.

openBrowser.description: Open the map in the browser at start.

restore.description: Run "dotnet restore" first for projects that were never restored, as "dotnet build" does.
